title: Wire BlockBelowChangedEvent through WebSocketBridge ParseEvent
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) — P1 finding

`BlockBelowChangedEvent` is defined in `WorldEvents.cs` (line 367) and handled in `AgentBackgroundService.cs` (line 1094), but `WebSocketBridge.ParseEvent` has NO `"blockBelowChanged"` case. The event falls through to `_ => null` and is silently discarded. Block-below tracking is completely broken — the `blockBelow`/`blockBelowType`/`blockBelowAt` facts in WorldState are never populated.

**Recommendation:** Add a `"blockBelowChanged" =>` case in `WebSocketBridge.ParseEvent` that parses the JSON fields (`name`, `type`, `x`, `y`, `z`) into a `BlockBelowChangedEvent`.
